CreateLeaseTemplate.name: CreateLeaseTemplate
CreateLeaseTemplate.documentation:
Creates a lease template.

Not idempotent: the identifier is generated server-side per invocation, so a retried request creates a second template. Callers must not retry.

DeleteBlueprint.name: DeleteBlueprint
DeleteBlueprint.documentation: Unregister (delete) a blueprint. 404 when it does not exist; 409 when it is still in use by one or more lease templates.

DeleteLeaseTemplate.name: DeleteLeaseTemplate
DeleteLeaseTemplate.documentation:
Deletes a lease template.

Idempotent: deleting a template that does not exist also returns success.

EjectAccount.name: EjectAccount
EjectAccount.documentation: Eject an account from ISB back to the Entry OU. 404 when missing; 409 while cleanup is in progress.

FreezeLease.name: FreezeLease
FreezeLease.documentation: Freeze an active lease. The success body is {"status":"success"}. 404 when the lease is missing; 409 when it is not active, an account is not in the expected state, or a competing critical operation holds the lock.

GetAccount.name: GetAccount
GetAccount.documentation: Get a single registered account by id. 404 when it does not exist.

GetBlueprint.name: GetBlueprint
GetBlueprint.documentation: Get a single blueprint (with StackSets and recent deployments) by id. 404 when it does not exist.

GetCleanupConfiguration.name: GetCleanupConfiguration
GetCleanupConfiguration.documentation: Reads the cleanup configuration section: its current values (or code defaults if never saved) plus the lastSavedBy audit field. Fails fast with 500 if the stored record fails schema validation (unlike GetConfigurations, which skips invalid sections). Accessible by Admin, Manager, and User roles.

GetConfigurations.name: GetConfigurations
GetConfigurations.documentation: Returns every configuration section plus the deploy-time fields the settings UI needs. A never-saved section is returned with its code-default field values, a null lastSavedBy, and no meta.

GetCostReportingConfiguration.name: GetCostReportingConfiguration
GetCostReportingConfiguration.documentation: Reads the costReporting configuration section: its current values (or code defaults if never saved) plus the lastSavedBy audit field. Fails fast with 500 if the stored record fails schema validation (unlike GetConfigurations, which skips invalid sections). Accessible by Admin, Manager, and User roles.

GetLease.name: GetLease
GetLease.documentation: Get a single lease by id. The leaseId is echoed on the returned lease. A caller without read access to an existing lease receives 403; a non-existent lease (for an authorized caller) receives 404.

GetLeaseAssignments.name: GetLeaseAssignments
GetLeaseAssignments.documentation: Get the assignments view for a lease. Admin/Manager may view any lease; other callers only their own (403 even when the lease does not exist, so existence is not leaked). 404 when the lease does not exist for an authorized caller.

GetLeaseTemplate.name: GetLeaseTemplate
GetLeaseTemplate.documentation:
Retrieves a single lease template.

A PRIVATE template is reported as 404 rather than 403 to callers without the Admin or Manager role, so the response does not disclose that the identifier exists.

GetLeasesConfiguration.name: GetLeasesConfiguration
GetLeasesConfiguration.documentation: Reads the leases configuration section: its current values (or code defaults if never saved) plus the lastSavedBy audit field. Fails fast with 500 if the stored record fails schema validation (unlike GetConfigurations, which skips invalid sections). Accessible by Admin, Manager, and User roles.

GetMaintenanceConfiguration.name: GetMaintenanceConfiguration
GetMaintenanceConfiguration.documentation: Reads the maintenance configuration section: its current values (or code defaults if never saved) plus the lastSavedBy audit field. Fails fast with 500 if the stored record fails schema validation (unlike GetConfigurations, which skips invalid sections). Accessible by Admin, Manager, and User roles.

GetNotificationConfiguration.name: GetNotificationConfiguration
GetNotificationConfiguration.documentation: Reads the notification configuration section: its current values (or code defaults if never saved) plus the lastSavedBy audit field. Fails fast with 500 if the stored record fails schema validation (unlike GetConfigurations, which skips invalid sections). Accessible by Admin, Manager, and User roles.

GetTermsOfServiceConfiguration.name: GetTermsOfServiceConfiguration
GetTermsOfServiceConfiguration.documentation: Reads the termsOfService configuration section: its current values (or code defaults if never saved) plus the lastSavedBy audit field. Fails fast with 500 if the stored record fails schema validation (unlike GetConfigurations, which skips invalid sections). Accessible by Admin, Manager, and User roles.

ListAccounts.name: ListAccounts
ListAccounts.documentation: Paginated list of registered sandbox accounts. maxResults caps at 2000.

ListBlueprints.name: ListBlueprints
ListBlueprints.documentation: Paginated list of registered blueprints (each with its StackSets). maxResults caps at 100. The collection is returned under blueprints (not result).

ListCleanupReports.name: ListCleanupReports
ListCleanupReports.documentation: Paginated recent cleanup reports for an account. maxResults caps at 10 (default 5).

ListLeaseTemplates.name: ListLeaseTemplates
ListLeaseTemplates.documentation:
Lists lease templates visible to the caller.

PRIVATE templates are filtered at the query layer for callers without the Admin or Manager role, so neither the result set nor the pagination token discloses a PRIVATE template's identifier.

ListLeases.name: ListLeases
ListLeases.documentation: Paginated list of leases. Admin/Manager callers list all leases (or filter by userEmail); a regular caller may only list their own (userEmail must be their own, else 403 AccessDeniedError). Each result item carries a leaseId. maxResults caps at 2000.

ListSharedLeases.name: ListSharedLeases
ListSharedLeases.documentation: Paginated list of leases shared with a user, by access path. Admin/Manager may query any user; a regular IDC caller may query only their own userId (else 403 AccessDeniedError; M2M callers without an elevated role are refused). Each item carries a leaseId, its accessType, and (for group access) sourceGroupName. maxResults caps at 100.

ListStackSets.name: ListStackSets
ListStackSets.documentation: Paginated CloudFormation StackSets available to attach to a blueprint. maxResults caps at 100.

ListUnregisteredAccounts.name: ListUnregisteredAccounts
ListUnregisteredAccounts.documentation: Paginated list of unregistered accounts in the Entry OU. maxResults caps at 20.

QuarantineAccount.name: QuarantineAccount
QuarantineAccount.documentation: Manually quarantine an account. 404 when missing; 409 when already quarantined or while cleanup is in progress.

RegisterAccount.name: RegisterAccount
RegisterAccount.documentation: Register an AWS account with ISB. Accepts only awsAccountId; rejects an ISB administration account (400) and unknown body keys (400, strict). Returns the registered account (201). The Entry->CleanUp Organizations move surfaces a 409 (ConflictError) when the account is no longer where expected (someone moved it out of the Entry OU) or the organization was concurrently modified — the same mapping the other OU-moving actions carry.

RegisterBlueprint.name: RegisterBlueprint
RegisterBlueprint.documentation: Register a blueprint from an existing CloudFormation StackSet. Returns the created blueprint (201). A missing StackSet is 404; a SERVICE_MANAGED (or otherwise unsupported) permission model is 400. Retry: not idempotent — a re-POST creates another blueprint.

RequestLease.name: RequestLease
RequestLease.documentation:
Request a new lease from a template. Returns the created lease (201) WITHOUT a leaseId. A cross-user (on-behalf) request is Admin/Manager only. assignments is capped at 19. New group-to-lease associations are rejected when leases.groupAssignmentMode is NONE; user assignments remain allowed.

Retry: NOT @idempotent. Requesting a lease allocates an account and publishes events; a retried request creates a second lease.

RetryCleanup.name: RetryCleanup
RetryCleanup.documentation: Re-drive cleanup for an account. 404 when missing; 409 when not in quarantine or already cleaning up.

ReviewLease.name: ReviewLease
ReviewLease.documentation: Approve or deny a pending lease. Body carries action (Approve/Deny). The success body is {"status":"success"}. A pending request that already contains a group can still be approved when leases.groupAssignmentMode is NONE; the mode blocks creation of new group-to-lease associations, not completion of an existing request. 404 when missing; 409 when the lease is not pending review or (on approve) no account is available.

SearchPrincipals.name: SearchPrincipals
SearchPrincipals.documentation:
Searches IDC principals for the assignment UI.

Two modes on one route, selected by exact:

  • fuzzy (exact=false, the default): case-insensitive substring match over the cached principals, capped at limit; requires leases.enablePrincipalSearch (else 403 AccessDeniedError);
  • exact (exact=true): resolves one principal by exact attribute through IDC; requires a non-empty q and a specific type (users or groups, not all) — otherwise 400 — and returns 404 when no principal resolves. Exact lookups bypass leases.enablePrincipalSearch, but group lookups still require leases.groupAssignmentMode to be ALL.

When leases.groupAssignmentMode is NONE, explicit fuzzy or exact group searches return 403, and unfiltered fuzzy searches return users only. Existing group associations remain visible through lease assignment reads.

Applies these defaults when a parameter is absent: q="", type=all, limit=20, exact=false.

This operation is not paginated: it is a typeahead search, not a list/describe. The caller shows the top limit matches (≤ 100) and never pages; totalMatches exists only so the UI can show "N of M".

SkipCooldown.name: SkipCooldown
SkipCooldown.documentation: Skip an account's active cleanup cooldown by resuming the durable execution. 409 when there is no active cooldown or callback to resume.

TerminateLease.name: TerminateLease
TerminateLease.documentation: Terminate a monitored lease. The success body is {"status":"success"}. A regular caller may terminate only their own lease and only when config permits (else 403 AccessDeniedError, checked before existence so it is not leaked). 404 when missing; 409 when not in a terminable state or a termination is already in progress.

UnfreezeLease.name: UnfreezeLease
UnfreezeLease.documentation: Unfreeze a frozen lease. Unlike freeze/terminate, this returns the updated lease (200) WITH the leaseId. 404 when missing; 409 when not frozen, an account is not in the frozen state, or a live lock rejects it.

UpdateBlueprint.name: UpdateBlueprint
UpdateBlueprint.documentation: Update a blueprint's mutable fields (and, when supplied, its StackSet-level deployment parameters). PATCH-style: every body member is optional. 404 when the blueprint does not exist. Retry: intentionally not @idempotent despite the legacy PUT method. Each call performs a partial read-modify-write and refreshes meta.lastEditTime, so retrying after an ambiguous response can apply another write or overwrite a concurrent edit.

UpdateCleanupConfiguration.name: UpdateCleanupConfiguration
UpdateCleanupConfiguration.documentation: Replaces the cleanup configuration section (full replacement — every section field is required). Uses optimistic concurrency: echo meta.lastEditTime from a prior read to detect a concurrent edit (409 ConflictError on mismatch); omit it on the first save. M2M callers are rejected with 403 — the audit trail requires a human email identity. Admin role only.

UpdateCostReportingConfiguration.name: UpdateCostReportingConfiguration
UpdateCostReportingConfiguration.documentation: Replaces the costReporting configuration section (full replacement — every section field is required). Uses optimistic concurrency: echo meta.lastEditTime from a prior read to detect a concurrent edit (409 ConflictError on mismatch); omit it on the first save. M2M callers are rejected with 403 — the audit trail requires a human email identity. Admin role only.

UpdateLease.name: UpdateLease
UpdateLease.documentation: Update a monitored (active) lease. PATCH semantics: every body member is optional. Returns the updated lease (200) WITHOUT a leaseId. The nullable members (maxSpend, expirationDate, costReportGroup) accept an explicit null to CLEAR the value. Non-monitored leases are rejected 400 (ValidationError); a missing lease is 404.

UpdateLeaseAssignments.name: UpdateLeaseAssignments
UpdateLeaseAssignments.documentation: Replace a lease's desired principal assignments (declarative). Accepted asynchronously: success is 202 with { desiredCount } — the assignment worker reconciles out of band. @idempotent: PUT sets the desired set, so a retry converges to the same state. assignments is capped at 19. Owner callers require lease sharing enabled globally and on the lease (else 403). When group assignment mode is NONE, existing group-to-lease associations may remain or be removed, but new associations are rejected. 404 when missing; 409 when the lease is not active or another operation holds the lock.

UpdateLeaseTemplate.name: UpdateLeaseTemplate
UpdateLeaseTemplate.documentation:
Replaces a lease template.

The body carries the full template, not a patch. uuid, createdBy and blueprintName are server-owned and are not part of the writable input; supplying them is rejected as an unknown member. createdBy is preserved from the existing template on write.

UpdateLeasesConfiguration.name: UpdateLeasesConfiguration
UpdateLeasesConfiguration.documentation: Replaces the leases configuration section. All configuration fields are required, including groupAssignmentMode. Existing records that predate this field are read as NONE, and the next save persists that value. Uses optimistic concurrency: echo meta.lastEditTime from a prior read to detect a concurrent edit (409 ConflictError on mismatch); omit it on the first save. M2M callers are rejected with 403 — the audit trail requires a human email identity. Admin role only.

UpdateMaintenanceConfiguration.name: UpdateMaintenanceConfiguration
UpdateMaintenanceConfiguration.documentation: Replaces the maintenance configuration section (full replacement — every section field is required). Uses optimistic concurrency: echo meta.lastEditTime from a prior read to detect a concurrent edit (409 ConflictError on mismatch); omit it on the first save. M2M callers are rejected with 403 — the audit trail requires a human email identity. Admin role only.

UpdateNotificationConfiguration.name: UpdateNotificationConfiguration
UpdateNotificationConfiguration.documentation: Replaces the notification configuration section (full replacement — every section field is required). Uses optimistic concurrency: echo meta.lastEditTime from a prior read to detect a concurrent edit (409 ConflictError on mismatch); omit it on the first save. M2M callers are rejected with 403 — the audit trail requires a human email identity. Admin role only.

UpdateTermsOfServiceConfiguration.name: UpdateTermsOfServiceConfiguration
UpdateTermsOfServiceConfiguration.documentation: Replaces the termsOfService configuration section (full replacement — every section field is required). Uses optimistic concurrency: echo meta.lastEditTime from a prior read to detect a concurrent edit (409 ConflictError on mismatch); omit it on the first save. M2M callers are rejected with 403 — the audit trail requires a human email identity. Admin role only.

AccessDeniedError.documentation: Caller authenticated but not authorized for this operation.

AccountMetadata.documentation: Record metadata. Only the timestamps are public.

status.documentation: The cleanup phase. Open string: enumerated phases plus NUKE_PHASE_<n>.

ActiveCleanup.documentation: In-flight cleanup summary attached to an account while it is being cleaned.

isbManagedRegions.documentation: Regions the account pool is configured to manage.

AdminConfiguration.documentation: The full configuration the settings UI loads: every section (each with its audit fields) plus the deploy-time fields resolved outside the config store.

AssignmentSyncStatus.documentation:
Per-principal reconciliation status of a lease assignment. Each in-flight state pairs with the failure it becomes if it never settles (granting → grantFailed, revoking → revokeFailed):

  • active — desired and assigned.
  • granting — desired, not yet assigned; an operation is in flight.
  • revoking — assigned but on its way out.
  • suspended — intentionally not assigned because the lease grants nobody access (frozen or terminal, or a freeze/terminate in flight); expected, not a failure.
  • grantFailed — desired and settled, but no assignment exists.
  • revokeFailed — settled, but an assignment exists that should not: either the principal is no longer desired, or the lease grants no access.

principalId.documentation: IDC user id (for USER assignments) or group id (for GROUP assignments).

principalType.documentation: Whether this is a direct user or a group assignment.

displayName.documentation: Display name of the user or group.

assigneeEmail.documentation: Email of the assigned user (USER assignments only).

addedBy.documentation: Email of the user who created this assignment. Absent for a principal that is desired but not yet granted.

isOwner.documentation: True for the lease owner, whose access is implicit and not removable.

isDesired.documentation: Whether the principal is in the lease's desired set. This cannot be inferred from syncStatus.

AssignmentView.documentation: One row of the assignments view: the union of a lease's desired set and its live assignments, annotated with reconciliation state. Rows sourced only from the desired set have no assignment yet, so assigneeEmail/addedBy/addedDate are absent.

BlueprintHealthMetrics.documentation: Aggregated blueprint health metrics (computed from all StackSets).

BlueprintId.documentation: A blueprint id — the server-generated UUID. The pattern is the exact RFC layout (versions 1–8, variant 8/9/a/b, plus the nil and max UUIDs), so a hex-shaped but RFC-invalid id is rejected 400 rather than returning 404.

BlueprintTagKey.documentation: Tag key: 1–128 chars from the CloudFormation-tag character set. The reserved aws: prefix is not allowed.

BlueprintTagValue.documentation: Tag value: up to 256 chars from the same set (empty allowed).

BlueprintWithStackSets.documentation: The composite a read path returns: the blueprint, its StackSets, and the most recent deployments.

cooldownPeriodHours.documentation: Hours to hold an account in the CleanUp OU after a successful cleanup before returning it to Available (0 = disabled; max 8640 = 360 days).

lastSavedBy.documentation: Email of the last administrator to save the section, or a system: sentinel.

CleanupExecutionContext.documentation: Deprecated legacy Step Function context, still emitted when present.

CleanupReportError.documentation: A cleanup failure: the failing step and its message.

CleanupReportStatus.documentation: Overall lifecycle status of a cleanup run.

CleanupStep.documentation: One appended cleanup step. meta carries step-specific data as an opaque map.

failureAction.documentation: Action taken when post-cleanup Resource Explorer validation finds resources remaining in the account.

ConcurrencyMode.documentation: CloudFormation StackSet concurrency mode — how concurrency reacts to failures.

lastEditTime.documentation: The optimistic-concurrency token: a write must echo the value it last read, or the store rejects it with a 409. Opaque — echoed back unchanged.

ConfigurationResponseMetadata.documentation: Response metadata. Both timestamps are @required: a saved section always carries both, and a partial meta must never be sent back — a meta missing lastEditTime would drop the concurrency token and silently downgrade the next write to a first-save.

ConfigurationWriteMetadata.documentation: Write-side metadata: only the optimistic-concurrency token. createdTime is server-owned and excluded; a first save omits lastEditTime entirely.

costReportGroups.documentation: Valid cost-report-group values selectable on lease templates.

requireCostReportGroup.documentation: Whether a cost report group is required on lease templates.

lastSavedBy.documentation: Email of the last administrator to save the section, or a system: sentinel.

CreateLeaseTemplateInput.documentation:
The client-writable members of a lease template, shared by the create and update inputs. Both accept the same set — requiredness and constraints are identical and neither operation is a patch.

uuid, createdBy and blueprintName are deliberately absent — they are server-owned.

data.documentation: The created template, placed directly in data rather than under a further key.

CurrentLease.documentation: The lease currently occupying the account, when one does.

DeleteBlueprintData.documentation: The delete success payload: a confirmation message plus the deleted blueprint id.

leaseTemplateId.documentation: Lease template UUID. The API Gateway path segment is named leaseTemplateName, but the value is the template's UUID, not its display name.

DesiredAssignment.documentation: A caller-supplied desired assignment: the target principal and its kind. Used by RequestLease and UpdateLeaseAssignments request bodies.

DesiredAssignmentWithDisplay.documentation: A desired assignment enriched with display metadata.

field.documentation: Dotted path to the rejected field, or input when not attributable to one field.

leaseTemplateId.documentation: Lease template UUID. The API Gateway path segment is named leaseTemplateName, but the value is the template's UUID, not its display name.

JSendErrorData.documentation: Failure payload. Populated for validation failures; absent on errors that carry only a top-level message.

userEmail.documentation: Lease owner / assignee email. Half of the composite key.

uuid.documentation: Server-generated lease UUID. Half of the composite key.

originalLeaseTemplateUuid.documentation: UUID of the lease template this lease was requested from.

originalLeaseTemplateName.documentation: Name copied from the template at request time.

createdBy.documentation: Set only for a cross-user (on-behalf) request; the elevated caller's email.

blueprintId.documentation: Blueprint copied from the template for deployment. Absent when the template had none.

desiredAssignments.documentation: Declarative desired principal assignments (owner + shared users/groups), each optionally enriched with display metadata for the assignments UI.

resourceLock.documentation: Record-level optimistic lock for in-flight assignment/lifecycle operations.

ttl.documentation: TTL as a Unix-epoch-seconds timestamp. Present on terminal/denied leases.

Lease.documentation: The public lease projection. Body-returning writes (RequestLease, UpdateLease) emit this WITHOUT leaseId; read paths emit LeaseWithId.

LeaseAssignmentsView.documentation: The assignments view plus the operation currently reconciling it.

LeaseId.documentation: A lease's public identifier: the base64url-encoded {userEmail, uuid} composite key (URL-safe alphabet, no padding). Present on read/unfreeze outputs and list items; absent from the Lease returned by RequestLease/UpdateLease.

LeaseLockIntent.documentation: Intent recorded on a lease's concurrency lock. Critical intents (TERMINATE, FREEZE) can preempt overridable ones (UPDATE, PUBLISH, UNFREEZE).

intent.documentation: The operation the lock was taken for.

LeaseMetadata.documentation: Lease record metadata: creation and last-edit timestamps.

ownerId.documentation: Identifier of the operation holding the lock.

expiresAt.documentation: When the lock expires; past this point the lock is treated as absent.

meta.documentation: Lease-specific lock context (the operation holding the lock).

LeaseResourceLock.documentation: A lease's record-level optimistic lock, held while assignment processing runs. Clients read it to gate lease actions; a lock whose expiresAt has passed is treated as absent.

blueprintName.documentation: Resolved from the blueprint store; not client-provided.

LeaseTemplate.documentation: Budget and duration settings shared by the template and its create input. The hour and dollar fields accept fractional values, so a 1.5-hour template is valid; each must be greater than zero.

LeaseTemplatePage.documentation: Paginated payload. nextPageIdentifier is null on the final page.

userEmail.documentation: Lease owner / assignee email. Half of the composite key.

uuid.documentation: Server-generated lease UUID. Half of the composite key.

originalLeaseTemplateUuid.documentation: UUID of the lease template this lease was requested from.

originalLeaseTemplateName.documentation: Name copied from the template at request time.

createdBy.documentation: Set only for a cross-user (on-behalf) request; the elevated caller's email.

blueprintId.documentation: Blueprint copied from the template for deployment. Absent when the template had none.

desiredAssignments.documentation: Declarative desired principal assignments (owner + shared users/groups), each optionally enriched with display metadata for the assignments UI.

resourceLock.documentation: Record-level optimistic lock for in-flight assignment/lifecycle operations.

ttl.documentation: TTL as a Unix-epoch-seconds timestamp. Present on terminal/denied leases.

LeaseWithId.documentation: A Lease that carries the leaseId (base64url composite key). Returned by GetLease and UnfreezeLease and as the ListLeases result items.

ttl.documentation: Number of days the solution stores expired lease records before purging them.

allowUserLeaseTermination.documentation: Whether users can self-terminate their own active leases.

leaseRequestWindowHours.documentation: Rolling window duration (hours) for rate-limiting lease requests.

maxLeaseRequestsPerWindow.documentation: Maximum number of leases a user can request within the rolling window.

leaseSharingEnabled.documentation: Whether the multi-user lease-sharing feature is globally enabled.

groupAssignmentMode.documentation: Controls whether IDC groups can be selected for lease assignments. Existing stored configurations that predate this policy are read as NONE. Existing group assignments are retained when set to NONE.

lastSavedBy.documentation: Email of the last administrator to save the section, or a system: sentinel.

ListAccountsResult.documentation: error is an optional validation-warning string forwarded verbatim; a non-contractual diagnostic, not a failure.

pageIdentifier.documentation: Opaque continuation token from a previous response. Server-owned; clients must not construct or interpret it.

maxResults.documentation: Maximum page size. The operation defaults it to 2000 when absent. A non-numeric, out-of-range, or repeated value is rejected as a 400.

ListLeasesResult.documentation: error is an optional diagnostic warning string. It is non-contractual, not a failure.

userId.documentation: The IDC user whose shared leases to list.

enabled.documentation: When true, prevents creation of new leases. Fresh installs default to true.

lastSavedBy.documentation: Email of the last administrator to save the section, or a system: sentinel.

createdTime.documentation: Time when the resource was created, as an ISO 8601 string.

schemaVersion.deprecatedMessage: Scheduled for removal in a future API version.

NotFoundError.documentation: The addressed resource does not exist, or the caller is not entitled to learn that it exists. A PRIVATE lease template returns this rather than a 403 to callers without the Admin or Manager role.

emailFrom.documentation: From address used for notification emails; an empty string disables notifications.

lastSavedBy.documentation: Email of the last administrator to save the section, or a system: sentinel.

principalId.documentation: IDC identifier for the user or group.

displayName.documentation: Human-readable name shown in the assignment UI. Optional: may be absent when the principal has no display name.

Principal.documentation: A resolved IDC principal in the search response.

totalMatches.documentation: Total matches before the limit cap (the returned list may be shorter).

PrincipalSearchResult.documentation: The data payload of a principal search: the (capped) matches plus the total that matched before limit was applied.

PrincipalSearchTypeFilter.documentation: The type query filter: restrict to users, groups, or both. The public wire values are lowercase.

PrincipalType.documentation: Whether a matched principal is an IDC user or group.

leaseTemplateUuid.documentation: Template to request from. Public request field name (not originalLeaseTemplateUuid).

userEmail.documentation: On-behalf target user. Omitted for a self-request.

meta.documentation: Domain-specific context the lock owner attaches; opaque string map.

ResourceLock.documentation: Record-level optimistic lock. Timestamps are ISO 8601 strings.

validationMode.documentation: Validation mode in effect: Quarantine enforces (a failed validation quarantines the account); Warn surfaces remaining resources without blocking; Silent records metrics only. Absent if validation did not run.

afterCleanup.documentation: Post-nuke, pre-cooldown snapshot (metrics-only). Diffed against afterCooldown to detect Resource Explorer staleness: resources present here but gone after cooldown are index ghosts that cleared during cooldown.

afterCooldown.documentation: Post-cooldown snapshot — the enforcement/validation result. A non-empty byType (after exclusions) indicates a validation failure.

ReviewAction.documentation: The review decision for a pending lease.

SandboxAccountStatus.documentation: The account's operational state (the ISB OU it sits in, excluding the transient Entry/Exit OUs). Registered accounts are always one of these.

q.documentation: Case-insensitive substring matched against display name and email.

limit.documentation: Maximum matches to return. The operation defaults it to 20 when absent.

exact.documentation: When true, resolve one principal by exact attribute instead of fuzzy search.

userEmail.documentation: Lease owner / assignee email. Half of the composite key.

uuid.documentation: Server-generated lease UUID. Half of the composite key.

originalLeaseTemplateUuid.documentation: UUID of the lease template this lease was requested from.

originalLeaseTemplateName.documentation: Name copied from the template at request time.

createdBy.documentation: Set only for a cross-user (on-behalf) request; the elevated caller's email.

blueprintId.documentation: Blueprint copied from the template for deployment. Absent when the template had none.

desiredAssignments.documentation: Declarative desired principal assignments (owner + shared users/groups), each optionally enriched with display metadata for the assignments UI.

resourceLock.documentation: Record-level optimistic lock for in-flight assignment/lifecycle operations.

ttl.documentation: TTL as a Unix-epoch-seconds timestamp. Present on terminal/denied leases.

sourceGroupName.documentation: The IDC group display name that granted access, present only for group access.

SharedLease.documentation: A Lease reachable through a shared assignment, with the access path and (for group access) the group that granted it. Also carries the leaseId.

SharedLeaseAccessType.documentation: The access path by which a shared lease reaches a user: a direct principal assignment or membership in an assigned group. Wire values are lowercase.

StackSetSummary.documentation: A CloudFormation StackSet summary. status/permissionModel are open strings (CloudFormation passthroughs; permissionModel may be absent in member accounts).

content.documentation: Terms-of-service text displayed to users before requesting a lease.

lastSavedBy.documentation: Email of the last administrator to save the section, or a system: sentinel.

UnauthenticatedError.documentation: Identity token missing, expired, invalid, or lacking required claims.

UnregisteredAccount.documentation: An AWS Organizations account in the Entry OU that has not been registered with ISB. Field names mirror the Organizations API (Id, Email, Name).

UnsupportedMediaTypeError.documentation: Content-Type is not a JSON media type. (An acceptable media type carrying an invalid or absent payload also currently returns 415.)

cooldownPeriodHours.documentation: Hours to hold an account in the CleanUp OU after a successful cleanup before returning it to Available (0 = disabled; max 8640 = 360 days).

costReportGroups.documentation: Valid cost-report-group values selectable on lease templates.

requireCostReportGroup.documentation: Whether a cost report group is required on lease templates.

UpdateLeaseAssignmentsResult.documentation: The count of desired assignments accepted for reconciliation.

leaseTemplateId.documentation: Lease template UUID. The API Gateway path segment is named leaseTemplateName, but the value is the template's UUID, not its display name.

meta.documentation: Accepted rather than ignored: the meta sent in the request is written back, overriding only createdTime. Omitting meta clears lastEditTime, so a client performing a read-modify-write must echo it back.

UpdateLeaseTemplateInput.documentation:
The client-writable members of a lease template, shared by the create and update inputs. Both accept the same set — requiredness and constraints are identical and neither operation is a patch.

uuid, createdBy and blueprintName are deliberately absent — they are server-owned.

ttl.documentation: Number of days the solution stores expired lease records before purging them.

allowUserLeaseTermination.documentation: Whether users can self-terminate their own active leases.

leaseRequestWindowHours.documentation: Rolling window duration (hours) for rate-limiting lease requests.

maxLeaseRequestsPerWindow.documentation: Maximum number of leases a user can request within the rolling window.

leaseSharingEnabled.documentation: Whether the multi-user lease-sharing feature is globally enabled.

groupAssignmentMode.documentation: Controls whether IDC groups can be selected for lease assignments. Existing stored configurations that predate this policy are read as NONE. Existing group assignments are retained when set to NONE.

enabled.documentation: When true, prevents creation of new leases. Fresh installs default to true.

emailFrom.documentation: From address used for notification emails; an empty string disables notifications.

content.documentation: Terms-of-service text displayed to users before requesting a lease.

Visibility.documentation: Lease-template visibility: PUBLIC templates are visible to all users; PRIVATE templates are visible only to Admin and Manager roles.

documentation:
Innovation Sandbox on AWS enables cloud administrators to automate the management of temporary sandbox environments by implementing service control policies, spend controls, and account recycling mechanisms.

The API is organized into these domains:

  • Accounts: Register and manage sandbox accounts, cleanup runs, and account lifecycle actions.
  • Blueprints: Register and manage CloudFormation StackSet-backed blueprints.
  • Configurations: Read and update solution settings for leases, cleanup, notifications, maintenance, terms of service, and cost reporting.
  • Leases: Request and manage temporary sandbox access, lifecycle actions, sharing, and principal assignments.
  • Lease templates: Define the reusable budget, duration, blueprint, and visibility settings used to request leases.
  • Principals: Search IAM Identity Center users and groups for lease assignments.
